mapper.sql: select d.id, d.parent_id, d.code, d.group_name, d.show_order, d."LEVEL", d.table_name, d.table_id from sys_sort d
mapper.select: SELECT ID,#{id} AS PARENT_ID,STRUTSTYPE AS CODE ,STRUTSNAME AS GROUP_NAME ,"SEQUENCE" AS SHOW_ORDER,'2' AS "LEVEL",'STRUTSTYPE' AS TABLE_NAME,STRUTSTYPE AS TABLE_ID FROM T_DA_STRUTSTYPE
SELECT ID,#{id} AS PARENT_ID,CARRIERTYPE AS CODE ,CARRIERTYPENAME AS GROUP_NAME ,ROWNUM AS SHOW_ORDER,'3' AS "LEVEL",'CARRIERTYPE' AS TABLE_NAME,CARRIERTYPE AS TABLE_ID FROM T_DA_CARRIERTYPE

SELECT ID,'4' AS PARENT_ID,sortcode AS CODE ,SORTNAME AS GROUP_NAME ,ROWNUM AS SHOW_ORDER,'4' AS "LEVEL",'SORTID' AS TABLE_NAME,SORTID AS TABLE_ID FROM T_DA_EXTSORT WHERE STRUTSTYPE =#{code} AND CARRIERTYPE =#{tableName} AND UNITID =#{tableId} ORDER BY SORTCODE ,"SEQUENCE"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SYS_SORT (ID, PARENT_ID, CODE, GROUP_NAME, SHOW_ORDER, "LEVEL", TABLE_NAME, TABLE_ID) VALUES(#{id}, #{parentId}, #{code}, #{groupName}, #{showOrder}, #{level}, #{tableName}, #{tableId})
